question: What is the Mean Absolute Deviation of nominal monthly net budget receipts of the U.S. Federal Government from Excise taxes for FY 2018 rounded to the thousandths place and in millions of dollars?
raw_response:
The 12 monthly values sum to 94,987, matching the printed "Fiscal year 2018 to date" net excise taxes total — confirming the series. Mean = 7,915.583 $M; Mean Absolute Deviation = 1,400.306 $M.

Source: Treasury Bulletin December 2018, Table FFO-2 (Net excise taxes, column 35), monthly Oct 2017–Sep 2018.

<FINAL_ANSWER>1400.306</FINAL_ANSWER>
